# Mercado Ventures

> Mercado Ventures Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based enterprise group working across business development, marine engineering, specialist maritime services and connected technology.

Canonical website: https://mercado.sg/

## Selected businesses and development initiatives

- [UX Marine](https://mercado.sg/#ux-marine): Marine product and vessel development, including the Noordic range.
- [Boat Sparky](https://mercado.sg/#boat-sparky): Marine electrical engineering, energy systems and systems integration.
- [Polska Marine](https://mercado.sg/#polska-marine): International maritime documentation and administrative services.
- [Neptune Tech](https://mercado.sg/#neptune-tech): Initiatives exploring marine communications, remote monitoring and connected infrastructure.

Corporate and commercial relationships vary. This list does not imply that every business is a subsidiary. The website is the source of the descriptions; it provides no investment-performance or assets-under-management claims.
